title: High-sensitivity plasma proteomics reveals disease-specific signatures and predictive biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease phenotypes in a large mixed dementia cohort
High-sensitivity plasma proteomics reveals disease-specific signatures and predictive biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease phenotypes in a large mixed dementia cohort-Abstract

paragraphs.origin_text: Highly sensitive plasma assays enable accurate blood-based biomarkers for neurodegenerative disease and provide minimally invasive options for clinical use. Large-scale studies encompassing multiple neurodegenerative diseases and utilizing multiplex platforms are essential to uncover disease-specific biomarkers and pathways. We generated and analyzed plasma proteomics using the NULISASeq
